title: RPSLS
author: jildos_legoplanet
selftext:
Inspired by a scientific research concept called the Nash Equilibrium I learned that human patterns can be identified through 8 different levels.

This inspired me to make a game that is super easy to learn but super hard to master: RPSLS (Rock, Paper, Scissors, Lizard, Spock) - for those who know, you know ;)

A playable alpha version can be found here (Flutter/Supabase/.NET stack): [https://polite-cliff-0ecee020f.7.azurestaticapps.net/forge/](https://polite-cliff-0ecee020f.7.azurestaticapps.net/forge/)

The first 4 characters are playable. I’m still working on a narrative based tutorial flow to introduce each pattern/rival.

**Five signs. Ten relationships.**

You may know Rock, Paper, Scissors. Here, the circle is wider. Each sign defeats two others — and falls to two. 

Learn the relationships:

\-Scissors cuts Paper  
\-Paper covers Rock  
\-Rock crushes Lizard  
\-Lizard poisons Spock  
\-Spock smashes Scissors  
\-Scissors decapitates Lizard  
\-Lizard eats Paper  
\-Paper disproves Spock  
\-Spock vaporizes Rock

And, as it always has… Rock crushes Scissors.

Should I continue with this? what do you think of the overall style?
